constructor.details: Locks the implementation so initialize() cannot be called on it directly.

params._lockPeriod: Lock period in seconds after removeNode (e.g. 7 days)
params._minStakeAmount: Minimum stake per node in wei (e.g. 1 ether)

params.composeHash: SHA384 of the normalised docker-compose yaml
params.firstSignerAddress: TEE EVM address of the first node
params.firstTeeUrl: Evidence URL of the first node
params.imageHashes: Docker image digests, one per service in compose order

acknowledgeApp(string).notice: Record that the caller has manually verified this app's TEE evidence.         Records the current ackVersion; becomes stale if updateApp or         updateNode is called afterwards.

addNode(string,address,string).notice: Add a node to an existing app. Only the app owner may add nodes.         msg.value is the stake for this node (>= minStakeAmount).         Does NOT invalidate existing acknowledgements (new node is trusted         via inter-node mutual RA).

getAckCount(string).notice: Total number of unique users who have ever acknowledged this app.

getNodeList(string).notice: All signer addresses ever added to the app (including removed ones).         A removed node has stakeAmount==0 and a pending UnstakeRequest.

initialize(uint256,uint256).notice: Initialise the proxy. Called once via BeaconProxy through delegatecall.

isAcknowledged(address,string).notice: Returns true if the user has acknowledged the current app version.

registerApp(string,bytes,bytes,bytes[],a.notice: Register a new app and add its first node atomically.         msg.value is the stake for the first node (>= minStakeAmount).

removeNode(string,address).notice: Remove a node and start the stake lock period.         Only the app owner may remove nodes.         Does NOT invalidate existing acknowledgements.

updateApp(string,bytes,bytes,bytes[]).notice: Update the shared code metadata for an app (e.g. after re-deployment).         Increments ackVersion, invalidating all prior acknowledgements.

updateNode(string,address,string).notice: Update a node's evidence URL (e.g. after an endpoint change).         Increments ackVersion, invalidating all prior acknowledgements.

withdrawNodeStake(string,address).notice: Withdraw a removed node's stake after the lock period elapses.
